The '''Chumai''' is a sept of the [[Taardad]] [[Aiel]]. The sept hold is unknown. When [[Tigraine Mantear|Shaiel]] was accepted as ''[[Far Dareis Mai]]'', she joined the Chumai sept.{{ref/book|4|34}} On their way to [[Alcair Dal]], [[Rand al'Thor]] and the [[Jindo]] are joined by other Taardad septs including the [[Nine Valleys]], Chumai, [[Four Stones]], [[Bloody Water]] and [[Miadi]] septs.{{ref/book|4|57}}
